causality: The three module names were absent for the full pre-fix history; pickaxe finds their first addition only in fix 7f39d972. Claude-coauthored commits 3084847c and 3e7bdbf4 expanded UNSAFE_IMPORTS with other dangerous modules while leaving the pre-existing treatment of linecache, difflib, and gc unchanged. Adding neighboring blocklist entries does not introduce the omitted-module bypass. The report also relies on unused_assignments and tuple-AST traversal behavior introduced in human commit ce3ace17. Claude appears in remediation and adjacent hardening, with no atomic AI change that created the vulnerable behavior.

evidence.atomic_binding: git log -S for linecache, difflib, and gc in fickle.py has no pre-fix introduction; all three first appear in the fix.
